title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 23.10.2026
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 22/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23/10/2026;
as per the Notification dated 22.09.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 22/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23/10/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble the Acting
Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak would sit Single
and take up the matters as per Roster.
3. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.S.Supehia would sit Single and
take up the notified matter/s.
4. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia would sit in
Larger Bench with Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai and Hon’ble
Mr. Justice D.N.Ray and take up the notified matters.
5. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen and Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit in Special Division Bench
and take up the notified matter/s.
6. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 5 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Sangeeta K. Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mool Chand Tyagi
would sit in Special Division Bench and take up the notified
matter/s.
7. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 6 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit Single and take up the notified
matters.
8. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
9. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 8 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.T.Vachhani would sit in
Regular Division Bench and take up the matters as per Roster.
10. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
11. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 10 and Sr. No. 15, Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Gita Gopi and Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit
in Regular Division Bench and take up the matters as per Roster.
12. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Nirzar S. Desai would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
13. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
14. At 02:30 PM Special Division Bench, Comprising Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Hemant M. Prachhak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mool Chand Tyagi, as
per Part-B of the Present Roster would not assemble.
15. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Pranav Trivedi would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
16. At 03:00 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev J. Thaker and Hon’ble Mr.
Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit in Special Division Bench and take
up the notified matter/s.
17. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
D. N. Ray would take up the specially assigned Arbitration matters
as per the Notification dated 22.09.2026.
18. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 6 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Mool Chand Tyagi would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
